title: 我的平价美白日记：告别黄黑皮

shots.visual_description: Creator looking slightly self-conscious or sighing about her skin, then her face brightens up as she holds the whitening face cream to the camera.
shots.narration: 学生党、贫民窟女孩看过来！这款平价美白面霜，让你白到发光。

shots.visual_description: Creator sits at her desk, looking at her phone, showing a 'before' selfie where her skin appears dull/tired. She sighs, expressing frustration.
shots.narration: 作为一名学生党，熬夜赶due是常态，皮肤暗沉、发黄简直是我的噩梦。总感觉自己是人群中最不起眼的‘黄黑皮’。
shots.text_overlay: 告别黄黑皮，从今天开始！

shots.visual_description: Creator excitedly unboxes the whitening face cream, showing the packaging details. She opens the jar, smells it, and expresses pleasant surprise. Close-up on the product texture.
shots.narration: 直到我发现了这款平价美白面霜！第一次用就爱上了它的清爽质地，闻起来也很舒服，感觉找到宝藏了！

shots.visual_description: Quick montage: Creator applying the cream in the morning (fresh-faced, natural light) and then in the evening (after cleansing, cozy setting). She massages it gently onto her face.
shots.narration: 每天早晚，我都会认真涂抹。它很好吸收，不搓泥，后续上妆也服帖。感觉皮肤每天都在喝水，慢慢变得透亮。

shots.visual_description: A montage of quick 'check-in' shots (e.g., Day 7, Day 14, Day 21) of the creator's face, showing subtle but increasing brightness and evenness. Text overlays like 'Day 7: 小有光泽', 'Day 14: 肤色均匀', 'Day 21: 明显提亮'.
shots.narration: 这是我坚持使用后的皮肤变化：一周小有光泽，两周肤色均匀，一个月后真的白了好几个度！黄气一扫而光！

shots.visual_description: Creator confidently faces the camera, glowing with radiant, even-toned skin. She might touch her cheek or hair, smiling genuinely.
shots.narration: 现在出门素颜也敢大大方方地走，再也不用厚厚的粉底遮盖了！皮肤变得又白又嫩，整个人都自信起来了！
shots.text_overlay: 素颜也敢出门，自信加倍！

shots.visual_description: Creator holds the product like a trusted friend, making eye contact. Text overlay: '我的美白秘密，你值得拥有！'. A clear call to action appears.
shots.narration: 如果你也想告别黄黑皮，拥有白皙透亮的肌肤，这款平价美白面霜，绝对是学生党的首选！快点击下方链接，开启你的美白之旅吧！

selling_points: 真实用户亲身体验，效果可见
记录皮肤从暗沉到透亮的蜕变过程
